mei: Heads-up 1 - two enterprise pilots and Legal asked for a single-page "jurisdiction onramp" that maps customer profile -> recommended isolation path + gating checklist. Need decision for roadmap kickoff.

derek: Can you sketch the customer profiles? e.g. 'privacy-first EU bank', 'SaaS analytics US (HIPAA adjacent)', 'startup dev sandbox'. Different profiles map to different defaults.

anil: My take: map to 3 default paths: 1) Hosted-Residency (data stays in region, platform-managed KMS) 2) Managed-Dedicated (reserved pools, SLA, optional CMK) 3) Private-Deploy (VPC/on-prem, full certs). Each path needs launch gates + sample contract language.

claire: Ops constraints: Managed-Dedicated requires scheduler reservations + burst policy, plus a visible quota dashboard. Also we must define fallback semantics (auto-fail to spare capacity vs reject) and whether that's allowed for each path.

mei: Good. Quick policy example for the routing DSL for Hosted-Residency: `route_policy: [{predicate: {region: "eu"}, action: {model_variant: "redwood-v1-eu", residency: true}}]`. We should include audit-retention defaults (365d) and opt-in CMK.

derek: Sales ask: show delta in cost & SLA in one slide. Finance needs cost multipliers: hosted baseline, managed-dedicated +2-3x, private +4x+. Can finance confirm rough bands?

anil: Infra estimate for minimal Hosted-Residency: routing rule + enforced region header + residency verification hooks ~3w; KMS opt-in + rotation integration ~2w; telemetry markers + audit retention config ~2w. Managed-Dedicated prototype about 8-10w.

claire: Launch gates we should require: perf cert (customer synthetic), residency proof (data verification), KMS key rotation test, canary customers (2), runbook + SRE oncall rota. Also contract clause for credits on missed cutover SLOs.

mei: Action items: Derek -> draft one-pager with cost deltas and customer profile mapping; Anil -> detailed infra plan + blockers; Claire -> SRE gate checklist + runbook template; I'll coordinate legal/commercial language. Target: converge before roadmap review (ts 2600002000).

sales-ops-bot: crm-bot: noted pilots: "NordBank-EU", "Healthlytics-US". Linked in CRM.

mei: Agree on priority: unblock Hosted-Residency first to close pilots, then schedule Managed-Dedicated design sprint.

claire: One more ops flag: ensure routing decisions include `route_reason` header for auditability. Without that, we can't satisfy some customers.

anil: ack - will add `X-Redwood-Route-Reason` and a short spec. I'll post RFC to product/rfc/jurisdiction-onramp by EOD.

mei: Thanks all. :thumbsup:
